name: Zettersfeld Sonnenbalkon Lienz
kurzbeschreibung: The sun-drenched Zettersfeld above Lienz features magnificent vistas of the Lienz Dolomites, family-friendly alpine paths, and high mountain hikes to the Neualplseen.
preis: Cable car round trip adults approx. €26.00, children reduced; free with Osttirol Card
oeffnungszeiten: Summer season mid-June to mid-October daily 09:00–17:00; winter operations December to April
beschreibung:
Overview

Zettersfeld is a sun-blessed high plateau gracing the slopes of the Schober Range high above East Tyrol's capital, Lienz. With its prime south-facing orientation and dramatic views of the limestone battlements of the Lienz Dolomites directly opposite, the mountain is the region's favourite outdoor retreat. Spanning elevations between 1,812 and 2,213 metres at Steinermandl, the plateau offers an inspiring panorama across the entire Lienz valley basin and the Drautal. In summer, lush pastures, flowering alpine roses, and crystalline tarns enchant hikers of all generations. In winter, the plateau becomes a reliable, family-friendly ski haven. Bordering Hohe Tauern National Park, the habitat remains pristine, sustaining alpine marmots and rare montane flora.

Route & Requirements

Ascent is carried out smoothly in two sections: first, the barrier-free Zettersfeldbahn (four-person gondola) ascends to the Zettersfeld hub (1,812 m), where a four-seater chairlift continues directly to Steinermandl at 2,213 metres. Wide alpine paths and a family theme trail around the lift stations provide straightforward, pushchair-friendly circuit walks (1–2 hours). Families especially appreciate the fun riddle stations and play features along the routes. For experienced hillwalkers, this serves as the trailhead for a magnificent mountain tour to the deep-blue Neualplseen lakes at 2,438 m (approx. 3.5 hours return, 450 m elevation gain, rocky trails). Comfortable leisure shoes are fine for pasture strolls, whereas proper hiking boots with grippy soles and trekking poles are required for the Neualplseen trek.

Visit & Arrival

Lienzer Bergbahnen on Zettersfeld run daily in summer from mid-June to mid-October between 09:00 and 17:00. Round-trip tickets are around €26.00 for adults, with discounts for children and free access with the Osttirol Card. The valley station is located in the Gaimberg district of Lienz, featuring ample free parking. By train, travel to Lienz station, where regular VVT buses link directly to the Zettersfeld gondola base.

Tips

Do not miss the mountain hike up to the picturesque Neualplseen lakes – one of East Tyrol's most celebrated photo spots, mirroring the surrounding three-thousand-metre peaks in clear water. Stop afterwards at traditional mountain chalets like Naturfreundehütte or Berggasthaus Faschingalm for homemade Schlipfkrapfen ravioli.
saison: Mitte Juni bis Anfang Oktober (Winterbetrieb Dezember bis April)
